title: Universal Secure Descentralized IDentity
tagline: DiDs solution using fingerprints under the NIST protocol with NFQ2 as the basis for creating keys from any IOS or android device
description:
UsDID uses the powerful Nebuia technology that allows any user with a smartphone and an internet connection to obtain biometric data from their fingerprints (under the NIST protocol with NFQT2 and W3E) and generate a wallet using the information from your biometrics. as a unique ID.

This procedure is found in a smart contract within the Polygon network with Higher performance with a transaction speed of up to 65,000 transactions per second. Polygon is a grate solution that is secure due to the results of the validation system.

Finally, a decentralized protocol is stored in IPFS, ensuring the integrity, availability and security of the "IDs"
how_its_made:
IPFS - Descentralized and secure storage for user credentials  
Polygon - transaction speed of up to 65,000 transactions per second. Polygon is a grate solution that is secure due to the results of the validation system.
NCNN - Neural network framework
NestJS - Backend and services for secure communications
Flutter - For development on ios and android devices with a user-friendly interface
Golang - biometric data processing
